summary: Iter28 public /careers/:slug frontend UX — all 9 requested flows tested end-to-end on preview URL and PASSED: (1) anonymous browse renders careers-page with dark header 'Join Government of Sierra Leone', '10 open positions' subheading, filters, and 10 posting cards each carrying careers-posting-<uuid> testid; (2) search 'Health' correctly narrows to 3 Health-related postings (Epidemiologist / Community Health Officer / Senior Midwifery Coordinator), clearing restores all 10; (3) ministry dropdown filters correctly (e.g. Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education → 3 cards, all matching); (4) posting card click updates URL to ?apply=<pid> and shows careers-apply-page + careers-posting-detail with title, ministry, department, location, grade, description; (5) careers-apply-back returns to listing; (6) form submission produces careers-apply-success panel with ref APP-D7EB5C49 matching APP-XXXXXXXX regex and 'Application submitted' text; (7) duplicate reapply with same email → 409, toast 'You have already applied to this posting.' shown, no new success panel; (8) 5-char resume_summary blocked by HTML5 minLength validation ('Please lengthen this text to 20 characters or more'); (9) transparency-careers-link exists on /transparency/government-of-sierra-leone header, href=/careers/government-of-sierra-leone, navigates correctly; (10) /careers/does-not-exist renders careers-404 with helpful copy; (11) admin@gov.sl login → /talent → applicant-kanban → kanban-col-applied contains the newly-submitted card with name 'UI Test Applicant', title 'TVET Coordinator', and the correct email. Preserved DB budget: only 1 successful application was created (well under the 2-max limit).

issues: The applicant kanban card does not visually surface the source='public_careers' badge. Card only shows name/title/email. Not required by acceptance criteria but would improve triage UX so admin can quickly distinguish citizen-submitted vs. internal applications. Minor / cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: PublicCareers.jsx correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with a dedicated axios instance (withCredentials:false) — good for anonymous flow; no auth token accidentally leaks.

Duplicate detection returns 409 with a string detail that is surfaced cleanly via `toast.error` — the current err?.response?.data?.detail extraction correctly handles both string and non-string detail shapes.
HTML5 validation minLength=20 on resume_summary works client-side; backend also enforces it (422) per iter28 backend tests — defense-in-depth is good.

File is 381 lines — well under the 700-line threshold and cleanly decomposed into Header/FilterBar/PostingCard/ApplyPanel/PostingHeader/ApplyForm/SuccessPanel sub-components. Good separation of concerns.
All interactive elements carry data-testid — testability is excellent.
